suffix: only .md or .txt files (or .json in data/) (asked for: {path})
no_overwrite: second brain notes are never overwritten; use file_append
no_json_append: JSON files can't be appended to; use file_write with the full content
over_cap: {path} would have {size} characters, over its limit of {limit} (it goes into every prompt). Don't grow it: rewrite it shorter, merging and dropping what is outdated, or ask the user to run /profile consolidate.
protected: {path} is configured by hand only (MCP servers and their policy); I can't change or read it
